address: 83/25 Liang Mueang Road, Surat Thani, 84000, Thailand
bio: This enchanting, almost English-looking country pub draws tourists like bees to honey. Boasting a bright, breezy vibe, it serves international favourites, from steak to pizzas and light snacks, with a tempting array of cocktails and craft beers. The fresh watermelon topped with dry salmon and served with a spicy salad dressing is sweet and juicy, while another popular local delicacy, bingsu, salted egg yolk, offers a creamy scent and texture. Smooth live music in the evenings....
